messages:
Maya: Hey SF folks — I'm flying into the office next Tue (5/7). Team of ~6, want outdoor seating if possible. Any spots near 1 Market/Embarcadero you’d recommend? Prefer veggie-friendly + not too fancy.

Kevin: Ferry Building Marketplace is my go-to — lots of stalls so everyone finds something. Hog Island for seafood, Mijita for tacos, and the patio by the Embarcadero is nice. :boat:

Ingrid: Gott's Roadside at the Ferry Building is quick and has veggie burger options. If you want sit-down w/ a view, The Slanted Door is pricier but great for a group.

Sanjay: +1 for Ferry Building. Also, if you want ramen and it's chilly, Ichiran/any ramen spot nearby is cozy. For outdoor + casual, Mijita has a big patio and good tacos.

Carmen: quick poll? lunchbot, can you do a 1-2 minute poll: Ferry Building stalls / Gott's / The Slanted Door?

lunchbot: Poll created by Carmen — Which should Maya try for a team lunch? (react to vote)
• Ferry Building stalls
• Gott's Roadside
• The Slanted Door

Kevin: Ferry Building stalls for me — easier for a mixed group.

Ingrid: Ferry Building too, but if it's super busy then Gott's.

Sanjay: Gott's if we want faster service.

Maya: Voting Ferry Building. Can someone save a spot on the patio if it wins?

lunchbot: Poll results — Ferry Building stalls: 3 votes, Gott's Roadside: 2 votes, The Slanted Door: 1 vote.

Kevin: Looks like Ferry Building wins. I can swing by and scope seating at 11:30 if that helps. @Maya who's coming?

Carmen: Count me in.

Ingrid: I'll come too, can bring a backup umbrella if it's drizzly. :umbrella:

Sanjay: I'm in. Also FYI — there's a small vegetarian stall (Blue Barn?) that does great bowls near the Ferry building entrance.

Maya: Amazing — thanks everyone! Will book travel and DM details. Appreciated :heart:
